name: PHS Pallets
description:
PHS Pallets connects Claude to the live product catalog of PHS Inc (Premier Handling Solutions), a US material-handling supplier since 1977.

Browse the catalog — Search ~100 plastic pallet SKUs across every category: stackable, rackable, nestable, heavy-duty, hygienic, export and spill-containment. Compare real specs (dimensions, static/dynamic load ratings, deck type, material, weight), live pricing and availability, or start from our actual best sellers with a built-in buying guide that matches pallet types to your use case.

Get a real quote — Ask for a quote on any pallets and quantity, and the request is filed directly with the PHS sales team — including an itemized subtotal, an estimated freight cost to any US ZIP code, and lead time. You'll receive a confirmation email, and our team follows up with final pricing. No payment ever happens in chat: quotes are paid via secure Stripe checkout through the emailed link or the PHS Pallets mobile app.

Track and reorder — Existing PHS customers can sign in without a password: a single-use 6-digit code is emailed to your account address and exchanged inside the conversation. Once signed in, view your quotes and order history, get live shipment tracking with carrier, tracking number, ETA and a full event timeline — or reorder your last shipment in one step at your previous unit pricing with a fresh freight estimate.

Built as a stateless gateway to our own production API: no data stored, six read-only tools, four strictly additive write tools, and anti-enumeration passwordless sign-in. Physical goods only, shipped residential and commercial across all 50 states. Documentation: https://mcp.phsinc.com/docs

_published_faq.name: How do I add PHS Pallets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PHS Pallets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.phsinc.com/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is PHS Pallets MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, PHS Pallets scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PHS Pallets MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PHS Pallets provides these MCP tools: get_pallet_details, login_with_code, my_orders, my_quotes, popular_pallets, reorder, request_login_code, request_quote, search_pallets, and track_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PHS Pallets?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PHS Pallets in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, Promotion Pros Catalog, RCO-A2A, and Square Yards.

_published_faq.name: Does PHS Pallets MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: PHS Pallets does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
PHS Pallets is developed by Premier Handling Solutions, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
